hint_unofficial_api: This adapter uses EcoFlow's app (unofficial) API, because the official Developer API does not return live data for PowerOcean systems. EcoFlow may change it at any time.
help_email: The same login you use in the EcoFlow app
help_deviceSn: Serial number of the inverter, e.g. RE11XXXXXXXXXXXX
help_throttleSeconds: The device pushes about every 2 s. States are written at most this often (1-60 s).
